title: 웹 기반 PBL환경에서 토론지원도구의 개발 및 적용

abstracts.value:
웹 기반 PBL에서 학습자는 일방적인 지식을 습득하는 것이 아니며, 다양한 생각과 배경 지식을 가진 동료 학습자들과 지식을 공유하고 의미를 협상해 나가는 과정을 통해 협력적 지식을 구축하는 사회적 학습 과정을 경험한다.
본 연구는 이러한 웹 기반 PBL 환경에서 협력적 문제 해결을 위해 학습자들이 서로의 생각을 명확히 표현하고 다양한 의견을 공유, 조율하는 담화 활동을 효과적으로 지원할 수 있는 도구의 필요성에 대한 인식에서부터 토론지원도구를 개발하고 적용하였다. 이를 위해 웹 기반 PBL환경에서 토론 활동을 지원하기 위해 PBL의 원리와 문제해결과정에서 필요한 요소들을 충실히 반영한 토론지원도구를 설계, 개발하고, 이를 현장에 실증적으로 적용했을 때 나타나는 토론지원도구에 대한 반응과 토론 활동 과정 및 학습 결과를 분석하였다. 마지막으로 토론지원도구에 대한 학습자들의 학습 과정과 결과에 기초하여 토론지원도구를 위한 설계 전략을 제시하였다.

This study was based on the idea that the learners needed a tool that could effectively support their discourse activities to clearly express their opinions and share and tune their diverse ideas in order to solve a problem collaboratively in the web-based PBL environment. In an attempt to support their discussions in the web-based PBL environment, a discussion supporting tool that reflected the principles of the PBL fully was designed, developed and applied on the field in an empirical manner. Then the results involved with the discussion and learning process were analyzed.
A consideration was made of the characteristics of the PBL and the conceptual frameworks of discussion supporting proposed by van Bruggen et al. (2003) in order to establish the theoretical foundation of the discussion supporting tool. The characteristics of the PBL included awareness, representation, reflection, and the teacher's support.
Being used as the theoretical base to develop the discussion supporting tool, the design principles of the discussion supporting tool were drawn based on the characteristics of the web-based PBL environment and according to the conceptual framework of discussion supporting. Then the specific elements and functions of each design principle were established.
Taking into account these results, the following conclusions were drawn as to the design strategies of the discussion supporting tool.
1. A learning strategy is required which can activate the activities before discussion.
2. The awareness of the learners should be considered in design.
3. Diverse cognitive tools must be provided for the learners' learning management. The diverse tools for learning management help them manage their learning process.
4. A strategy should be set up to structurize the learners' discussion effectively. The structurization strategy including visualization can help the learners express their opinions clearly about the issue or others' ideas and easily understand the many ideas and opinions that are exchanged actively during discussion, thus contributing to their representation and reflection.
